segments.normalizedSource: The functions in this group use the following operation for a complex-to-complex transform:

```c N = 1 << Log2N; scale = 0 < Direction ? 1 : 1./N; // Define a complex vector, h: for (j = 0; j < N; ++j) h[j] = C->realp[j*IC] + i * C->imagp[j*IC]; // Perform Discrete Fourier Transform. for (k = 0; k < N; ++k) H[k] = scale * sum(h[j] * e**(-Direction*2*pi*i*j*k/N), 0 <= j < N); // Store result. for (k = 0; k < N; ++k) { C->realp[k*IC] = Re(H[k]); C->imagp[k*IC] = Im(H[k]); } ```
